course_name_original: PRACTICĂ PEDAGOGICĂ DE SPECIALITATE iN iNVĂTĂMĂNTUL PREUNIVERSITAR (1)
course_name_en: TEACHING PRACTICE IN COMPULSORY PRE-UNIVERSITY EDUCATION
prerequisites: Passing the Didactics of Specialization course
Learning outcomes specific to the Didactics of Specialization course

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of the organization and functioning of a pre-university educational institution.
Identification of curriculum documents specific to compulsory education.
Conceiving and designing curriculum documents specific to compulsory education.
Formation of practical skills in teaching-learning-evaluating technical and technological knowledge.
Knowledge, understanding, and use of specialized language.
Responsible execution of professional tasks, under conditions of restricted autonomy and qualified assistance.
Familiarization with the roles and activities specific to group and team work.

syllabus_topics: Organizational structure of the school unit
General knowledge activities of the school
Organization of teacher collectives in schools
Image of the school locally, nationally, and internationally
Collaboration of the school with the family
Analysis of curriculum documents specific to compulsory education
School curriculum specific to technical fields
Methodological guides for teaching, methodological guides for applying curriculum framework plans specific to the field
Regulation of organization and functioning of the application school
Design of curriculum documents specific to compulsory education
Study of existing textbooks, confrontation with the school curriculum and related material base in the school
Planning and design of evaluation activities
Participation in demonstrative specialized lessons supported by the mentor
Notes and discussions on demonstrative lessons supported by the mentor

assessment_methods.method: Intermediate tests (creating a school curriculum, a calendar plan, and a learning unit project)
Final evaluation (presentation of the pedagogical practice portfolio to the practice supervisor)

assessment_rules: The final grade for practice is composed of two components: 50% from intermediate tests (creating a school curriculum, a calendar plan, and a learning unit project) and 50% from the final evaluation (presentation of the pedagogical practice portfolio). The minimum final grade for promotion is 7. During the semester, systematic observation of students, individual/team assignments, preparation of a case study report, formative evaluation tests, and a summative evaluation test may be used, but no specific weight is assigned to these.
